description: Unit test class for the IntValueValidator class, testing validation logic for integer values in headers.

classes.name: IntValueValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing the behavior of IntValueValidator.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the validator instance before each test.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that IntValueValidator class instances are immutable.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullDefinition
methods.description: Tests that passing null as definition throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToAcceptNullValue
methods.description: Tests that accepting null value throws DittoHeaderInvalidException.

methods.name: canValidateInteger
methods.description: Checks that the validator correctly supports Java primitive int and wrapper Integer types.

methods.name: acceptValidCharSequence
methods.description: Verifies that a valid integer string ('2') is accepted without exception.

methods.name: doesNotValidateAsDefinedJavaTypeIsNotInt
methods.description: Ensures that non-integer header definitions are not validated as ints.

methods.name: acceptInvalidCharSequence
methods.description: Checks that an invalid integer string ('true') triggers an exception.
